name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Keshon Gilbert
comment: Gilbert (hip) won't play in Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: RayJ Dennis
comment: Dennis (Achilles) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Nolan Traore
comment: Brooklyn general manager Sean Marks announced Monday that Traore underwent right knee surgery and won't play in Summer League, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.

name: Brandon Miller
comment: Miller (shoulder) provided an update on his rehab after surgery in comments to Roderick Boone of The Charlotte Observer on Tuesday.

name: PJ Hall
comment: The Hornets announced Thursday that Hall underwent a procedure to address a fractured right ankle and will miss the remainder of the 2025-26 campaign.

name: Dailyn Swain
comment: Swain is out for Friday's Summer League game against the Cavaliers due to right wrist soreness, per K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network.

name: Zach Collins
comment: Collins (toe) agreed to a two-year, $17 million extension with Chicago on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Josh Giddey
comment: Giddey (ankle) could benefit from the selections of Caleb Wilson and Dailyn Swain as well as Chicago's acquisition of Nic Claxton (finger) in 2026-27.

name: Rob Dillingham
comment: Dillingham recently underwent successful minor surgery to have a ganglion cyst removed from his right wrist, the Bulls announced Wednesday.

name: Kyrie Irving
comment: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri offered an encouraging update on Irving's recovery Friday, saying the veteran guard is "right there" as he works toward returning to game action, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said Friday that Lively (foot) is "making good progress" in his recovery, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Santi Aldama
comment: Aldama (knee) is expected to be ready in time for training camp, according to NBA reporter Marc Stein.

name: Trevon Brazile
comment: Brazile is out for Sunday's Summer League finale for undisclosed reasons, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) is still in the relatively early stages of his recovery and has only recently begun getting back on the court, according to Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Steven Adams
comment: Adams (ankle) didn't offer a return timetable Monday at media day, per Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram had surgery on his foot/heel during the offseason, ESPN's Brian Windhorst reported Tuesday.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (hip) agreed to a two-year, $13.2 million contract with Los Angeles on Thursday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
comment: Niederhauser has been diagnosed with a Lisfranc injury in his right foot and will require surgery. He's been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
comment: Pippen (toe) has a chance to begin the new year as Memphis' starting point guard after Portland acquired Ja Morant in a trade with the Grizzlies earlier this offseason.

name: Walter Clayton Jr.
comment: Clayton (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League title game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

name: Karim Lopez
comment: Lopez (undisclosed) is out for Sunday's Summer League championship game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.

name: Richie Saunders
comment: Saunders was selected by the Grizzlies with the No. 32 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft.

name: Jaylen Wells
comment: Wells (toe) should continue competing for rotation minutes on the wing despite Memphis adding Cameron Boozer with the No. 3 overall pick.

name: Zach Edey
comment: Edey's (ankle, elbow) role becomes more intriguing following Memphis' addition of Cameron Boozer.

name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
comment: Antetokounmpo (knee) did not participate in Greece's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he focused on preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

name: Bam Adebayo
comment: Adebayo's (back) fantasy outlook should remain strong after Miami acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo, though his offensive role could shift alongside another high-usage frontcourt star, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sentinel opines.

name: Trevor Keels
comment: Keels (knee) didn't play in Friday's 101-87 Summer League win over the Pistons.

name: Ryan Conwell
comment: Conwell (hip) won't play again during the Las Vegas Summer League, per Tim Reynolds of Associated Press.

name: Myron Gardner
comment: Gardner (ankle) won't participate in the Las Vegas Summer League, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

name: Kevin Porter Jr.
comment: Porter exercised his $5.39 million player option for the 2026-27 campaign Thursday, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo will undergo surgery Sunday to repair a ruptured right Achilles tendon that he suffered during the Timberwolves Game 4 win over the Nuggets on Saturday.

name: Bryce McGowens
comment: McGowens (toe) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves.

name: Mohamed Diawara
comment: Diawara (finger) didn't play in Friday's 110-88 Summer League loss to the Mavericks.

name: Ajay Mitchell
comment: Thunder general manager Sam Presti has mentioned Mitchell (calf) multiple times as a player who could take on more minutes and make a jump this season, according to Brandon Rahbar of Daily Thunder.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber will be limited to begin training camp, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (back) will be limited when training camp begins, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports

name: Isaiah Hartenstein
comment: Hartenstein (ankle) participated in an offseason workout with the Thunder on Monday, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Otega Oweh
comment: Oweh (lower leg) didn't play in Sunday's 108-90 Summer League loss to the Nets.

name: Franz Wagner
comment: Wagner (calf) did not participate in Germany's latest FIBA World Cup qualifying window as he focuses on preparing for the 2026-27 NBA season.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: The Magic announced Monday that Nelson will undergo surgery to repair a fracture in his left ankle, and he's expected to return to basketball activities in 3-4 months.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) will return to the Magic on a one-year deal, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Adem Bona
comment: Bona (foot) will be re-evaluated at the start of training camp, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

name: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
comment: Caldwell-Pope (finger) agreed to a buyout with the Grizzlies on Saturday and plans to sign a one-year, $3.9 million contract with the 76ers, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Duop Reath
comment: Reath (foot) agreed to a one-year veteran minimum contract with the Suns on Wednesday, John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM reports.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: CJ Huntley
comment: Huntley (hamstring) is out for Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League finale versus the Spurs, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

name: Ja Morant
comment: Morant is set to share the playmaking duties with Damian Lillard in Portland's starting backcourt after being traded from Memphis.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Damian Lillard
comment: Lillard (Achilles) defeated Devin Booker and Kon Knueppel in the final round of Saturday's 2026 State Farm 3-Point Contest, taking home his third title.

name: Keegan Murray
comment: Murray (ankle) is projected to start at power forward for the Kings in 2026-27, according to Kings beat writer Chris Watkins.

name: Zach LaVine
comment: LaVine (hand) exercised his $49 million player option for 2026-27 on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: De'Andre Hunter
comment: Hunter (eye) has a major competitor for usage after the Kings took Darius Acuff in the 2026 WNBA Draft.

name: David Jones Garcia
comment: Jones Garcia (ankle) agreed to a two-way contract with the Spurs on Wednesday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (lower leg) was spotted in a walking boot Wednesday, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.

name: Alijah Martin
comment: Martin (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

name: Chucky Hepburn
comment: Hepburn (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet reports.

name: Collin Murray-Boyles
comment: Murray-Boyles (finger) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Nuggets, Zulfi Sheikh of sportsnet reports.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
comment: With Walker Kessler now in Los Angeles, Jackson (knee) figures to be an even more essential piece for the Jazz in 2026-27, per ESPN's Tim MacMahon.

name: Trey Alexander
comment: Alexander (rib) is out for Friday's Summer League game against Portland, per Ben Anderson of KSL News Salt Lake City.

name: Anthony Davis
comment: General manager Will Dawkins said during Thursday's press conference that Davis (finger) is "very much a motivated player" and that he expects the veteran big man to bounce back in 2026-27.

name: Alex Sarr
comment: Sarr will be a partial participant when training camp begins as he continues his recovery from surgery to repair a fractured right foot,Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

name: Trae Young
comment: Young (quadriceps) has been doing sand-dune workouts during the offseason, and his trainer discussed the guard's outlook and leadership criticism Monday, Mark Medina of RG reports.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
